meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 Signal 消息渠道，实现原生收发。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里直接收发 Signal 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Signal channel for native messaging.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send and receive Signal messages in your app.

howto.what: 装上后,助手用 signal-cli 以你手机的「关联设备」身份接入 Signal:用现有号码收发消息,无需新号码或机器人 API。
howto.when: 当你要给助手添加 Signal 渠道时触发(通常在 /setup 流程中);也用于重新生成设备链接二维码、或改用专用号码注册。

say.text: 帮我把 Signal 接入助手,用我手机上的号码扫码链接
say.note: 会安装 signal-cli 并显示二维码等你扫描

say.text: 二维码过期了,重新生成一个链接
say.note: 重跑设备链接步骤,新链接约 3 分钟有效

say.text: 我想用专用号码注册 Signal,不做设备链接
say.note: 需先过验证码,再做短信或语音验证

howto.what_en: Once installed, your assistant connects to Signal via signal-cli as a linked secondary device: it sends and receives as the number on the phone that scans the QR, so no new number or bot API is needed.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to add Signal as a channel to your assistant (usually inside the /setup flow), to get a fresh device-link QR code, or to register a dedicated number instead.

say_en.text: Add Signal to my assistant and link it with my phone number
say_en.note: Installs signal-cli and shows a QR code to scan

say_en.text: The QR expired, generate a fresh link
say_en.note: Re-runs the device-link step; links last ~3 minutes

say_en.text: Register a dedicated Signal number instead of device linking
say_en.note: Needs a captcha plus SMS or voice verification
